idea-plugin.name: KSeF FA
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the lines KSeF will reject in a Polish structured invoice XML, before you send it

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → KSeF FA: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/ksef-fa3-invoice-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/ksef-fa3-invoice-lint

action.description: Run KSeF FA on the file in the editor
